analysis: This PR changes docs/provider/cli-reference.md in two places: the 'Last updated' date at line 3 (2026-10-23 to 2026-10-24) and a source-path reference at line 1816 (DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED now points to libs/mlx-swift-lm/Libraries/MLXLMCommon/GatedDelta.swift instead of MLXLLM/Models/GatedDelta.swift). The supplied head text (lines 400-1288) is unchanged context that mostly restates provider CLI behavior. That context covers drain/stop/restart, logout token revocation to the recorded issuer only (HTTP 204 confirms; no redirects; token sent as bearer, not logged), the model cache location, Autopilot consent, fan helper commands and KV posture. These are documentation of existing behavior and match the threat model's A-008, T-053 and TB-011 descriptions. No code, authorization, encryption, attestation, cache-storage or lifecycle logic changes, so no security controls, trust boundaries or threat assumptions are altered. T-041 (prefix cache) text is not affected. Remaining unverified items: whether the cited GatedDelta.swift path matches the actual source tree (the file move is outside the supplied evidence) and whether the unchanged documentation matches the implementation. Neither is a security regression from this PR.
